description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Suricata EVE JSON IDS/NSM records relayed as one JSON object per line, with fixture-backed alert, DNS, HTTP, TLS, flow, fileinfo, anomaly, SSH, DHCP, RDP, FTP, Kerberos/KRB5, SMB, MQTT, HTTP/2, PostgreSQL/PGSQL, Netflow, ARP, IKE, Modbus, QUIC, and POP3 families.

normalized_fields.suricata_eve_family: Native EVE event_type for supported families: alert, dns, http, tls, flow, fileinfo, anomaly, ssh, dhcp, rdp, ftp, krb5, smb, mqtt, http2, pgsql, netflow, arp, ike, modbus, quic, or pop3
normalized_fields.transport: Uppercase proto derived from Suricata proto
normalized_fields.action: Suricata alert.action or flow.action when present; otherwise event_type fallback
normalized_fields.signature: Alert signature or family-specific triage value
normalized_fields.ssh_client_hassh: ssh.client.hassh.hash when Suricata HASSH logging is enabled
normalized_fields.ssh_server_hassh: ssh.server.hassh.hash when Suricata HASSH logging is enabled
normalized_fields.dhcp_hostname: dhcp.hostname client host name when extended logging emits it
normalized_fields.dhcp_lease_time: dhcp.lease_time lease duration when extended logging emits it
normalized_fields.rdp_protocol: rdp.protocol selected security protocol where present
normalized_fields.rdp_cookie: rdp.cookie client-provided routing/cookie string where present
normalized_fields.rdp_client_name: rdp.client.client_name where connect-request logging emits client details
normalized_fields.ftp_command_data: ftp.command_data argument/filename context for FTP records
normalized_fields.ftp_completion_code: ftp.completion_code response code array for FTP records
normalized_fields.ftp_reply: ftp.reply response text array for FTP records
normalized_fields.krb5_msg_type: krb5.msg_type Kerberos message type such as AS-REQ/TGS-REP
normalized_fields.krb5_encryption: krb5.encryption response encryption type when emitted
normalized_fields.krb5_error_code: krb5.error_code when a Kerberos request fails
normalized_fields.smb_command: smb.command command name for SMB transaction records
normalized_fields.smb_status: smb.status status string for SMB records
normalized_fields.smb_status_code: smb.status_code hex status code for SMB records
normalized_fields.smb_filename: smb.filename file/pipe name where Suricata emits it
normalized_fields.smb_share_type: smb.share_type such as FILE, PIPE, PRINT, or unknown
normalized_fields.mqtt_topic: mqtt.publish.topic published topic for MQTT publish transactions
normalized_fields.mqtt_message_id: mqtt.publish.message_id or transaction message identifier where emitted
normalized_fields.mqtt_client_id: mqtt.connect.client_id when CONNECT logging emits it
normalized_fields.http2_authority: HTTP/2 :authority pseudo-header from request headers when extracted by Splunk props
normalized_fields.http2_method: HTTP/2 :method pseudo-header from request headers when extracted by Splunk props
normalized_fields.http2_path: HTTP/2 :path pseudo-header from request headers when extracted by Splunk props
normalized_fields.http2_status: HTTP/2 :status pseudo-header from response headers when extracted by Splunk props
normalized_fields.http2_user_agent: HTTP/2 user-agent header when extracted by Splunk props
normalized_fields.arp_hw_type: arp.hw_type link-layer protocol type for ARP records
normalized_fields.arp_proto_type: arp.proto_type internetwork protocol for ARP records
normalized_fields.arp_opcode: arp.opcode request/reply operation for ARP records
normalized_fields.arp_src_mac: arp.src_mac source MAC address for ARP records
normalized_fields.arp_dest_mac: arp.dest_mac destination MAC address for ARP records
normalized_fields.ike_init_spi: IKE initiator Security Parameter Index from Suricata EVE IKE records.
normalized_fields.ike_resp_spi: IKE responder Security Parameter Index from Suricata EVE IKE records.
normalized_fields.ike_version_major: IKE/ISAKMP major version; distinguishes IKEv1 and IKEv2.
normalized_fields.ike_exchange_type_verbose: Human-readable IKE exchange type when Suricata extended IKE output is enabled.
normalized_fields.ike_alg_enc: Chosen IKE encryption algorithm observed by Suricata.
normalized_fields.ike_alg_hash: Chosen IKE hash/integrity algorithm observed by Suricata.
normalized_fields.ike_alg_auth: Chosen IKE authentication algorithm observed by Suricata.
normalized_fields.ike_alg_dh: Chosen IKE Diffie-Hellman group observed by Suricata.
normalized_fields.modbus_id: modbus.id transaction number assigned by Suricata for Modbus records.
normalized_fields.modbus_request_function: modbus.request.function_code associated function name for the request.
normalized_fields.modbus_response_function: modbus.response.function_code associated function name for the response.
normalized_fields.modbus_access_type: modbus.request.access_type or response access type such as READ | COILS.
normalized_fields.modbus_error_flags: modbus.response.error_flags or request error flags from Suricata parser context.
normalized_fields.quic_version: QUIC protocol version observed by Suricata EVE.
normalized_fields.quic_sni: QUIC Server Name Indication when Suricata emits it.
normalized_fields.quic_ja3_hash: QUIC JA3 client fingerprint hash when emitted.
normalized_fields.quic_ja3_string: QUIC JA3 client fingerprint string when emitted.
normalized_fields.quic_ja3s_hash: QUIC JA3S server fingerprint hash when emitted.
normalized_fields.quic_ja3s_string: QUIC JA3S server fingerprint string when emitted.
normalized_fields.quic_ja4: QUIC JA4 client fingerprint string when emitted.
normalized_fields.quic_cyu_hash: CYU fingerprint hash for pre-standardization QUIC variants when emitted.
normalized_fields.quic_cyu_string: CYU fingerprint string for pre-standardization QUIC variants when emitted.
normalized_fields.pop3_command: pop3.request.command POP3 client command observed by Suricata.
normalized_fields.pop3_args: pop3.request.args POP3 command arguments when emitted; can include mailbox/account identifiers and should be reviewed before reduction.
normalized_fields.pop3_success: pop3.response.success boolean POP3 response success flag.
normalized_fields.pop3_status: pop3.response.status such as OK or ERR.
normalized_fields.pop3_header: pop3.response.header first-line POP3 response text where emitted.

explicit_gaps: Live Suricata sensor/source-version emission, ruleset behavior, and local eve-log configuration are not proven by this harness.
Collector wrappers, file-tail buffering, syslog envelope rewrites, archive decompression, and Cribl/Fluent Bit/Vector delivery semantics remain unverified.
Suricata TSV logs, non-EVE outputs, stats-volume routing, local policy extensions, and real PCAP-derived traffic/source coverage remain deferred until exact source-shape evidence is added.

timestamp_policy.notes: Fixtures use Suricata-style timestamp strings with an explicit +0000 offset.

field_delimiting.notes: Each record is compact EVE JSON with a synthetic marker field for fixture validation only.

source.reference: Official Suricata EVE JSON output/format documentation, Suricata public repository/configuration evidence, and parser-ecosystem corroboration from Elastic Suricata EVE integrations; fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples shaped to public documentation, including FTP, Kerberos/KRB5, SMB, MQTT, HTTP/2, PGSQL, Netflow, ARP, IKE, Modbus, QUIC, and POP3 event fields added in 2026-06-16 hardening.
source.notes: Fixtures use example.test names, RFC5737 documentation IP ranges, synthetic signatures, and synthetic flow IDs; no customer or production sensor data.

curation.notes: Selected from 2026-06-13 source-coverage canvas top new-source backlog; Suricata EVE JSON had strong public emitted-shape/schema evidence. 2026-06-16 hardening added official Suricata EVE FTP, KRB5, SMB, MQTT, HTTP/2, PGSQL, Netflow, ARP, IKE, Modbus, QUIC, and POP3 fixture-backed coverage.

event.duration.notes: Suricata EVE JSON helper mapping added for PGSQL/Netflow fixture-backed coverage; not complete schema validation.

database.statement.notes: Suricata EVE JSON helper mapping added for PGSQL/Netflow fixture-backed coverage; not complete schema validation.

pack_variants.label: Suricata EVE JSON relay
pack_variants.description: Suricata EVE JSON records preserving native event_type, network tuple, and nested alert/DNS/HTTP/TLS/flow/fileinfo/anomaly/SSH/DHCP/RDP/FTP/KRB5/SMB/MQTT/HTTP2/PGSQL/Netflow/ARP/IKE/Modbus/QUIC context.
known_limitations: No live Suricata relay replay/read-back captured.
Suricata eve-log configuration and version can materially change optional nested fields.

Only alert, dns, http, tls, flow, fileinfo, anomaly, ssh, dhcp, rdp, ftp, krb5, smb, mqtt, http2, pgsql, netflow, arp, ike, modbus, and quic families are fixture-backed; other EVE event types remain future coverage.

cribl.notes: Use after sampling the local Suricata EVE feed. Do not drop event_type, timestamps, flow_id, network tuple, alert signature/severity, DNS/HTTP/TLS names, or flow counters by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

validation_commands: Start Data Prepper with the generated pipelines.yaml in a disposable test container and confirm pipeline startup before replay/read-back.
data_prepper.notes: Data Prepper support is recorded as a conservative OpenSearch ingestion pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Data Prepper pipeline artifact is generated by this pack yet.

opensearch_dashboards.config_model: index pattern/data view -> saved objects NDJSON -> dashboard/visualizations
validation_commands: Import exported NDJSON into a disposable OpenSearch Dashboards space and confirm data view/index-pattern resolution.
opensearch_dashboards.notes: OpenSearch Dashboards support is recorded as visualization-target metadata only. Splunk dashboards, where present, have not been automatically translated to OpenSearch saved objects or live-tested.

known_limitations: No live Suricata EVE relay, SC4S runtime replay, or Splunk read-back evidence; keep curated/unverified and do not promote to validated/verified.
Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent examples, not real sensor records.

Only alert, DNS, HTTP, TLS, flow, fileinfo, anomaly, SSH, DHCP, RDP, FTP, KRB5, SMB, MQTT, HTTP2, PGSQL, Netflow, ARP, IKE, Modbus, and QUIC records are fixture-backed; other official EVE event types remain future coverage.
Local Suricata version, eve-log configuration, ruleset metadata, and collector wrappers affect field presence and nesting.
Reduction candidates are opt-in and review-required; no default lossy drops are included.
